title: Seconds Before Chaos Erupts
description:
► Sonoran Desert Institute 
Learn more today at https://www.sdi.edu/code-blue-cam/  

On September 2, 2023, an officer spotted a driver not wearing a seat belt, along with the other occupants in the vehicle in La Crosse, WI. Upon investigation, the officer learned that the driver's driving privileges had been revoked due to past offenses and proceeded to make an arrest. The driver resisted the arrest and displayed erratic behavior, all in the presence of his children.

► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
